source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The single-delete test first waits for one tree row, then waits until getAllLogins returns five entries. The remove-all test first waits for zero tree rows, then waits until the stored login list is empty. A UI update and a storage commit are separate test milestones. The source uses async predicates; the external polling helper and browser/storage behavior were not executed here.
title: Password deletion tests wait for storage after the dialog tree changes
